name: C & I Leasing PLC
source: C and I Leasing Plc unaudited consolidated income statement for the second quarter ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), group six months column, thousands scaled to naira. Revenue is the printed gross earnings. Lease expenses and finance cost are netted inside gross earnings in this lease format, so cost of sales, gross profit and net finance costs are not printed as standalone lines and are left blank. Operating expenses are impairment, depreciation, personnel and other operating expenses. EPS as printed in kobo converted to naira, confirmed against 2,948,577,000 shares. | AfricanFinancials (audited summary) | CRON 2026-10-13: FY2025 profit before tax and the income tax credit taken from the audited C & I Leasing Plc AFS for the year ended 31 December 2025 (directors' report summarised group results), read from the filed PDF. | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column from the C and I Leasing Plc note 14.2.1 condensed results of consolidated entities in its unaudited financial statements for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026, NGX doclib, group column, printed in N thousand and stored as absolute naira. Gross earnings 38,823,342; net operating income 21,868,565; operating profit 11,744,485; finance cost 10,118,320; share of profit from joint venture 697,986; profit before tax 2,324,151; income tax 493,950; profit after tax 1,830,200. Ties at one thousand rounding. The primary statement in this filing did not expose a machine readable column layout, so the filed note table carrying the same 30 September 2026 group result was used. | CRON 2026-11-21: 9M 2026 EPS filled from the printed note 43 of C and I Leasing Plc unaudited consolidated financial statements for the third quarter ended 30 September 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), which prints basic earnings per share of 50.69 kobo (nine months to 30 September 2025: 57 kobo). 50.69 kobo equals 0.5069 naira. Cross-check: the printed profit after tax attributable to ordinary shareholders of 1,494,730 thousand divided by 2,948,577 thousand weighted average ordinary shares equals 0.5069, the same figure the face of the income statement prints.
